name: notebook-note-app
description: A notebook and sticky notes app for creating, editing, and organizing notes.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('public', {recursive: true}); ['index.html','style.css','script.js'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'public/' + f); }); console.log('Build complete');"
